crime: Her mentor always reserved a cue for {WITCH_NAME} in the recreation room, so the two of them could play together. Lesson after lesson, she rehearsed the opening shot on a working miniature of the pool table. But today, her mentor removed the miniature and invited her to play a real game at once, offering her the reserved cue.

Instead, {WITCH_NAME} made a working miniature of the sword in the lounge. She slashed her mentor's throat with the tiny blade, inflicting a fatal wound, then placed the bloodstained original sword beside her mentor. The prisoners took it for the murder weapon.

Then one prisoner pulled an engraved blade tip from the throat wound. Comparing it with the full-size sword, the prisoner found the original tip intact; the fragment bore the same engraving at a reduced scale. The scaled engraving exposed {WITCH_NAME}'s trick to the prisoners: the fragment had come from a miniature murder weapon, while the original sword was only a decoy.
fields.epitaph: She mistook an invitation to play for a farewell.
execution: The execution stand clamps her flat to a giant pool table. On the table, a miniature cue strikes a cue ball, playing the opening shot she rehearsed lesson after lesson. Then a giant cue ball rolls from her feet to her head, crushing the full length of her body. Once it passes, she lies still on the table.

magic.name: Working Miniatures
magic.text: Create miniature copies of inanimate objects that retain every function of the originals.
